subject.title: Show local Codex credit fallback as remaining percent

question: Should `com.steipete.codexbar.localrecovery` intentionally diverge from the upstream app by converting a Codex credits fallback into a remaining percentage whenever a limit is present?
rationale: The code is mechanically narrow, but choosing an alternate-bundle-only display contract is a product and support-policy decision rather than an established current behavior contract.

options.title: Approve the local-recovery policy
options.body: Accept the bundle-specific percentage display after the contributor supplies redacted before/after evidence from the freshly built local-recovery app.

options.title: Keep the existing credit display
options.body: Reject the alternate-bundle exception and retain raw credits in both bundles until a broader display-policy design is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the local-recovery policy
recommendation.body: Accept the bundle-specific percentage display after the contributor supplies redacted before/after evidence from the freshly built local-recovery app.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-specific bundle and menu-bar product-direction choice.
